integrity: Proof based on exact total-infection identity and stable-filter limits; numerical example is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic normalized positive-rate SIRA with prevalence-generated awareness, prescribed newborn allocation and beta=gamma+mu; global infection clearance and sharp tails, not stochastic extinction or supercritical stability.
title: Universal critical clearance and a two-scale inaccessible-infection tail in an awareness–fatigue epidemic
